Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh

Ct. No.10
 b.das
 Cpan 1042 of 2022
 in
 Wpa 24178 of 2019

Mr. Abhik Sarkar
 Mr. Barun Chatterjee
 ...for the applicants/petitioners.

Mr. Chandi Charan De
 Mr. S. K. Haldar ...for the alleged contemnor.
Affidavit of part compliance submitted on behalf of  the alleged contemnor is taken on record.

Learned counsel for the alleged contemnor submits  that in compliance with the order of this Court rate report  and estimated cost of compensation have been prepared  by observing the provision of The Right to Fair  Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 at Rs. 4,62,
 005/- The rate report and estimated cost of  compensation have been approved by the District  Magistrate, Bankura and Additional District Magistrate  issued a letter to the requiring body being the Executive  Engineer, (7th respondent in the writ petition)
